name: GitHub Actions
free_limit: GitHub Free: $12/month included shared compute allowance (roughly 2,000 Linux 2-core runner minutes); standard hosted runners free for public repos
watch_out: The included private-repository allowance is now a dollar-denominated shared compute budget, NOT a guaranteed 2,000 minutes on every runner OS; Windows/macOS and cloud sandbox usage draw at different rates. Public standard hosted runners and self-hosted runners remain free; public larger runners are billable. Artifacts/Packages share a separate 500 MB Free storage allowance; extra use is blocked without a valid payment method or charged when billing is enabled.
